summary: Recent updates to the WebGPU backend in Firefox, which enables high-performance graphics processing for web applications, focus on various enhancements and bug fixes. This includes **improvements to how the swap chain parameters are remembered at creation**, which can lead to better performance and stability during graphics rendering. Additionally, the maximum buffer size for WebGPU has been increased to its safe limit, allowing developers to handle larger datasets and produce more complex graphics without running into limitations. These changes are crucial for advancing web-based gaming and graphics applications, making them faster and more efficient.
